args: Payout net formula check via payment-linked refunds

Once refunds are matched to the actual payments inside each payout (not just by calendar month), does net = gross - fee - refunds hold cleanly, confirming refunds are reflected once and only once in what we pay merchants?

{"run": "run6", "manager": "data", "analyst": "Yuki Tanaka", "engineer": "Ines", "situation": "metric-certification", "week": 1, "night": 2, "request": 3, "grain": "calendar month, 2023-01 through 2025-12, based on payout paid_at month", "columns_requested": ["month", "payout_gross_eur", "payout_fee_eur", "payout_net_eur", "linked_refunds_eur", "implied_net_eur", "diff_eur", "diff_pct"], "details": "For each payout, identify its settled payments via payout_items (payout_items.payout_id = payouts.id, payout_items.payment_id = payments.id). linked_refunds_eur for a month = sum of payment_refunds.amount (status='succeeded') where payment_refunds.payment_id is one of the payments settled in a payout whose paid_at falls in that month, converted to EUR via exchange_rates using payment_refunds.currency_code and processed_at date (refunds counted regardless of when they were processed, i.e. a refund processed any time against a payment that ended up in this month's payout). payout_gross_eur/payout_fee_eur/payout_net_eur = sum of payouts.gross_amount/fee_amount/net_amount for payouts with paid_at in that month, converted to EUR via payouts.currency_code and paid_at date. implied_net_eur = payout_gross_eur - payout_fee_eur - linked_refunds_eur. diff_eur = payout_net_eur - implied_net_eur. diff_pct = diff_eur / payout_net_eur * 100, rounded to 1 decimal. Tables: payouts, payout_items, payments, payment_refunds, exchange_rates. Order by month ascending.", "builds_on": ["Payout reconciliation to gross, fees and refunds"]}
